acoustic.healthy: A healthy electric motor running smoothly with a steady hum.
acoustic.rotor_unbalance: An unbalanced electric motor rotor producing a rhythmic low vibration and rumble.
acoustic.rotor_misalignment: A misaligned electric motor producing periodic vibration and mechanical buzzing.
acoustic.stator_winding: An electric motor with a damaged stator winding producing a harsh electrical buzz.
acoustic.voltage_unbalance: An electric motor with unbalanced voltage producing an uneven electrical hum.
acoustic.bowed_rotor: An electric motor with a bent rotor producing periodic rubbing and vibration.
acoustic.broken_rotor_bars: An electric motor with broken rotor bars producing a pulsating modulated hum.
acoustic.faulty_bearing: An electric motor with a damaged bearing producing rough grinding and rattling.
